package.description: Free remote desktop tool for secure peer to peer screen sharing, remote control, file transfer, and chat.

en-US.description: Free remote desktop tool for secure peer to peer screen sharing, remote control, file transfer, and chat.
en-US.longDescription:
HopToDesk is a free remote desktop tool for Windows, Mac, Linux, Android, and iOS. Share your screen, provide remote assistance, transfer files, and chat with the remote partner.
Traffic is protected by end-to-end encryption between all connected peers, which means HopToDesk cannot see user screens, files, or any information shared between partners during a remote session.
A practical tool for providing remote support, managing remote servers, and performing remote administration. No complicated setup is required. HopToDesk is free for both personal and business use.
en-US.name: HopToDesk
